titleEn: BPSC School Teacher TRE 4.0 Recruitment 2026 Out For 32,388 Posts
excerptEn: BPSC has released a notification for the recruitment of TRE 4.0 School Teachers on its official website. This recruitment is for approximately 32,388 positions. Online application starts on 21 September 2026.
contentEn:
# BPSC School Teacher TRE 4.0 Recruitment 2026: The Ultimate Guide for Aspirants

The Bihar Public Service Commission (BPSC) has officially rolled out the much-awaited notification for the **BPSC School Teacher TRE 4.0 Recruitment 2026**. With an impressive vacancy count of **32,388 posts**, this recruitment drive opens up a golden opportunity for teaching aspirants across the nation. This exhaustive guide provides an in-depth look into every single aspect of this recruitment, from application procedures and eligibility criteria to an extensive syllabus breakdown, rigorous preparation strategies, and career progression.

## 1. Introduction to BPSC TRE 4.0
The Teacher Recruitment Examination (TRE) conducted by BPSC has transformed the educational landscape of Bihar. Now in its fourth iteration (TRE 4.0), the examination aims to fill 32,388 positions spanning across Primary (Class 1-5), Middle (Class 6-8), Secondary (Class 9-10), and Senior Secondary (Class 11-12) levels. The recruitment guarantees job security, prestige, and an opportunity to contribute directly to the state's intellectual growth.

## 2. Key Highlights of the Notification
- **Total Posts:** 32,388
- **Online Application Start Date:** 21 September 2026
- **Online Application Last Date:** 21 October 2026
- **Fee Payment Last Date:** 21 October 2026
- **Application Fee:** ₹100 for all categories
- **Exam Date:** To be notified later
- **Result Date:** To be notified later

## 3. Important Dates & Deadlines
Mark these dates on your calendar. Punctuality in filling the application is crucial.
- **Notification Release:** September 2026
- **Application Window:** 21 September 2026 to 21 October 2026
- **Admit Card Release:** 7-10 days prior to the exam
- **Document Verification:** Post-result declaration

## 4. Vacancy Breakdown (Total 32,388 Posts)
While the exact subject-wise breakdown is detailed in the official notification, the 32,388 posts are categorically divided into:
- Primary Teachers (Classes 1 to 5)
- Middle School Teachers (Classes 6 to 8)
- Secondary Teachers (Classes 9 to 10)
- Senior Secondary Teachers (Classes 11 to 12)
- Special Educators

## 5. Application Fee & Payment Details
Unlike many state-level exams, BPSC has kept the fee incredibly affordable:
- **All Categories:** ₹100/-
- **Payment Modes:** Debit Card, Credit Card, Internet Banking, IMPS, Cash Card, Mobile Wallet.
Always keep a copy of the payment receipt for future reference.

## 6. Comprehensive Age Limit (As on 01 August 2026)
Age criteria dictate eligibility severely. Here is the breakdown:
- **Minimum Age (Class 1-8):** 18 Years
- **Minimum Age (Class 9-12):** 21 Years
- **Maximum Age (UR-Male):** 37 Years
- **Maximum Age (UR-Female):** 40 Years
- **Maximum Age (BC/EBC - Male & Female):** 40 Years
- **Maximum Age (SC/ST - Male & Female):** 42 Years
*Age relaxations apply as per government rules.*

## 7. Eligibility Criteria: Educational Qualifications
The educational prerequisites are strict and level-specific.
### Primary School Teacher (Class 1-5)
- Bachelor’s Degree with 50% Marks + B.Ed OR
- Bachelor’s + D.El.Ed OR
- 10+2 with 50% Marks + 2-Year D.El.Ed / 4-Year B.El.Ed
- **Must be CTET Paper I or BTET Paper I qualified.**

### Middle School Teacher (Class 6-8)
- Graduate + 2-Year D.Ed OR
- Graduate / Post Graduate with 50% Marks + B.Ed OR
- Graduate with 50% Marks + BA B.Ed / B.Sc Ed
- **Must be CTET Paper II or BTET Paper II qualified.**

### Secondary School Teacher (Class 9-10)
- Graduate / Post Graduate in relevant subject with 50% Marks + B.Ed OR
- 4-Year BA.Ed / B.Sc.Ed
- **Must be STET Paper I qualified.**

### Senior Secondary Teacher (Class 11-12)
- Post Graduate in relevant subject with 50% Marks + B.Ed OR
- Post Graduate with 55% Marks + 3-Year B.Ed-M.Ed
- **Must be STET Paper II qualified.**

## 8. Step-by-Step Guide: How to Apply Online
1. **Visit Official Site:** Go to http://www.bpsc.bih.nic.in/.
2. **Registration:** Complete initial registration to get login credentials.
3. **Login & Fill Details:** Enter educational, personal, and communication details.
4. **Upload Documents:** Upload scanned passport-size photograph, signature, and necessary certificates.
5. **Fee Payment:** Pay ₹100 online.
6. **Submit & Print:** Final submit and print the application form.

## 9. Selection Process
The BPSC TRE 4.0 follows a rigorous selection procedure:
1. **Written Examination:** Objective type (MCQ) based on OMR sheets.
2. **Merit List Generation:** Based on written exam scores.
3. **Document Verification (DV):** Authenticating all claims regarding age, education, and category.

## 10. Exam Pattern Detailed Analysis
The exam consists of two parts for all categories:
- **Part I (Language Qualifying):** English (25 Marks) + Hindi/Urdu/Bengali (75 Marks). Total 100 Marks. Qualifying marks: 30%.
- **Part II (Main Subject + General Studies):** The ratio of Subject to General Studies differs per class level (typically 80 marks for subject and 40 marks for GS). No negative marking in TRE generally, but refer to official notification for specifics.

## 11. In-depth Syllabus Analysis
### General Studies (Common for all)
- **Primary Math & Reasoning**
- **General Awareness & Current Affairs**
- **General Science**
- **Indian National Movement & Geography**
- **Environmental Studies**

### Subject Specific (Classes 9-12)
Candidates must choose their core subject (History, Mathematics, Science, English, etc.). The difficulty level matches graduation standards for Class 9-10 and Post-Graduation standards for Class 11-12.

## 12. Detailed Job Profile & Responsibilities
Being a BPSC Teacher is a prestigious yet demanding role.
- **Lesson Planning:** Designing daily and weekly lesson plans.
- **Execution:** Imparting knowledge strictly adhering to the SCERT/NCERT curriculum.
- **Evaluation:** Regularly assessing student progress through tests and assignments.
- **Extracurricular Activities:** Managing school events, sports, and cultural programs.
- **Administrative Duties:** Maintaining attendance, progress reports, and aiding in election or census duties when mandated by the state.

## 13. Comprehensive Salary Breakdown & Allowances
The salary structure for BPSC Teachers is highly lucrative, governed by the new state rules for teaching staff.
- **Basic Pay:** Ranges from ₹25,000 (Primary) to ₹32,000 (Senior Secondary).
- **Dearness Allowance (DA):** Varies as per current state DA rates (often around 46%-50%).
- **House Rent Allowance (HRA):** Ranges from 4% to 16% depending on the posting city (Rural vs. Urban).
- **Transport/Medical Allowance:** Fixed ₹1,000 medical allowance and varying transport allowances.
- **Gross Salary:** Ranges from ₹40,000 to ₹55,000+ per month depending on the level and posting.

## 14. Career Growth & Promotions Hierarchy
A BPSC school teacher enjoys a structured promotional avenue:
1. **Teacher (Class 1-5 / 6-8 / 9-10 / 11-12)**
2. **Senior Teacher / Headmaster (Primary/Middle)**
3. **Principal (High School / +2 School)**
4. **Block Education Officer (BEO) / District Education Officer (DEO)** (through departmental exams or prolonged seniority).

## 15. Previous Year Cut-off Trends
Looking at TRE 1.0, 2.0, and 3.0, the competition is fierce.
- **Primary Level UR:** Generally ranges between 65-75 out of 120.
- **Secondary (Maths/Science):** Ranges from 70-85 out of 120.
- **Senior Secondary:** Heavily depends on the subject; highly competitive subjects like History or Physics see cut-offs around 60-75.

## 16. Exam Difficulty Level
The difficulty level is generally categorized as **Moderate to Tough**. The General Studies section, particularly the Indian National Movement and Bihar's Geography, requires deep conceptual clarity.

## 17. Preparation Strategy & Recommended Books
- **SCERT/NCERT Books:** Absolute necessity. Read from Class 6 to 12 for your specific subjects.
- **General Studies:** Lucent’s General Knowledge, Crown Bihar General Knowledge.
- **Current Affairs:** Read local newspapers like Dainik Jagran and monthly magazines like Pratiyogita Darpan.
- **Mock Tests:** Practice OMR-based offline mock tests to manage time efficiently.

## 18. Document Verification Preparation
Prepare a file with originals and two sets of self-attested photocopies of:
- 10th and 12th Marksheets and Certificates.
- Graduation/PG Degrees.
- B.Ed / D.El.Ed Certificates.
- CTET / STET / BTET Certificates.
- Domicile Certificate (if claiming reservation).
- Caste/NCL/EWS Certificate (if applicable).

## 19. Exam Day Guidelines
- Carry the downloaded Admit Card.
- Carry an original Photo ID (Aadhar preferred).
- Blue/Black Ball Point Pen for OMR marking.
- Reach the center at least 2 hours before the scheduled commencement to clear biometric verification.

## 20. Frequently Asked Questions (FAQs)
**Q: Can final year appearing students apply?**
A: Refer to the specific cut-off date (usually document issuance date must be prior to the application deadline).

**Q: Is CTET paper 2 required for class 9-10?**
A: No, STET Paper 1 is mandatory for class 9-10.

**Q: Can candidates from other states apply?**
A: Generally, yes, but they will be considered under the Unreserved (UR) category and must fulfill CTET/STET requirements.

## 21. Important Links
- **Apply Online:** Available from 21 September 2026.
- **Download Notification:** bpsc.bih.nic.in
- **Official Website:** bpsc.bih.nic.in

## 22. Conclusion
The BPSC School Teacher TRE 4.0 Recruitment for 32,388 posts is a golden ticket for educators. With structured salary, immense respect, and job stability, it represents the pinnacle of government teaching jobs in Bihar. Start your preparation immediately with a focused approach towards NCERT/SCERT books. Best of luck to all aspirants!
